text.description_html:
Don-Jo 1160147-SS, Stainless Steel Push and Pull Handle Set

The Store Door Push and Pull Handle Set comes packaged as a set including one 9" Center to Center (CTC) offset door pull. It is made from 1" diameter stainless steel round bar stock. Packaged with mounting hardware. Choose from a satin or polishes stainless steel finish.

Specifications for the Don-Jo 1160147-SS Stainless Steel Storedoor Push and Pull Handle Set:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Pull Diameter: 1"
  • Pull Center to Center (CTC): 9"
  • Push Bar Diameter: 1"
  • Push Bar Center to Center (CTC): 33"
  • Packaged with Mounting Hardware

*Sold as a Set (for 1 door). Made to order. NOT Returnable.
